items.raw_excerpt: 36氪获悉，国内视频博主“影视飓风”团队在节目中表示：已入驻全球最大的B2B出海平台阿里国际站，全面应用AI来开拓海外市场。36氪独家获悉，目前影视飓风的海外店铺已收到30多国客户发来的合作意向。据介绍，影视飓风团队使用了国际站平台上的多个AI Agent，把其此前在国内电商平台上售卖的商品信息一键翻译、生成适配海外市场的多语言介绍和推广视频，并自动装修，快速把海外店铺开起来。同时，影视飓风在接待海外客户时，也大量使用了平台的AI Agent辅助接待。

title_i18n.es: Media Storm se une a Alibaba International, utilizando agentes de IA para expandir negocios en el extranjero.

excerpt_i18n.en: 36Kr has learned that the domestic video blogger team "Film Storm" announced in a program that they have joined Alibaba International Station, the world's largest B2B cross-border platform, and are fully utilizing AI to expand into overseas markets. According to exclusive information obtained by 36Kr, Film Storm's overseas store has already received cooperation inquiries from clients in over 30 countries. It is reported that the team employed multiple AI agents on the platform to instantly translate product information previously sold on domestic e-commerce platforms, generate multilingual descriptions and promotional videos tailored for overseas markets, and automatically set up the store, enabling rapid launch. Additionally, Film Storm extensively uses the platform's AI agents to assist in engaging with overseas clients.
excerpt_i18n.es: 36Kr se ha enterado de que el equipo del videoblogger chino "Film Storm" ha declarado en un programa que se ha unido a Alibaba.com, la mayor plataforma global de B2B para la expansión internacional, utilizando ampliamente la IA para explorar el mercado exterior. Según información exclusiva de 36Kr, la tienda internacional de Film Storm ya ha recibido intenciones de colaboración de clientes de más de 30 países. Se informa que el equipo ha empleado múltiples agentes de IA en la plataforma de Alibaba.com para traducir automáticamente la información de productos previamente vendidos en plataformas de comercio electrónico nacionales, generando descripciones multilingües y videos promocionales adaptados al mercado internacional, además de decorar automáticamente la tienda, permitiendo una rápida apertura en el extranjero. Asimismo, Film Storm ha utilizado extensamente los agentes de IA de la plataforma para atender a clientes internacionales.

items.title: AI coding is sexy, but accounting is the real low-hanging automation target
items.raw_excerpt:
Working on automating small business finance (bookkeeping, reconciliation, basic reporting). One thing I keep noticing: compared to programming, accounting often looks like the more automatable problem: It’s rule-based
Double entry, charts of accounts, tax rules, materiality thresholds. For most day-to-day transactions you’re not inventing new logic, you’re applying existing rules. It’s verifiable
The books either balance or they don’t. Ledgers either reconcile or they don’t. There’s almost always a “ground truth” to compare against (bank feeds, statements, prior periods). It’s boring and repetitive
Same vendors, same categories, same patterns every month. Humans hate this work. Software loves it. With accounting, at least at the small-business level, most of the work feels like: normalize

title_i18n.en: AI coding is sexy, but accounting is the real low-hanging automation target
title_i18n.zh: AI编程虽具吸引力，但会计才是唾手可得的自动化目标。
title_i18n.es: La programación con IA es atractiva, pero la contabilidad es el verdadero objetivo de automatización fácil de alcanzar.

excerpt_i18n.en:
Working on automating small business finance (bookkeeping, reconciliation, basic reporting). One thing I keep noticing: compared to programming, accounting often looks like the more automatable problem: It’s rule-based
Double entry, charts of accounts, tax rules, materiality thresholds. For most day-to-day transactions you’re not inventing new logic, you’re applying existing rules. It’s verifiable
The books either balance or they don’t. Ledgers either reconcile or they don’t. There’s almost always a “ground truth” to compare against (bank feeds, statements, prior periods). It’s boring and repetitive
Same vendors, same categories, same patterns every month. Humans hate this work. Software loves it. With accounting, at least at the small-business level, most of the work feels like: normalize
excerpt_i18n.zh: 致力于自动化小型企业财务（记账、对账、基础报表）。我常注意到一点：相比编程，会计往往看起来是更易自动化的问题：它基于规则。
excerpt_i18n.es: Trabajando en automatizar las finanzas de pequeñas empresas (contabilidad, conciliación, informes básicos). Algo que sigo observando: en comparación con la programación, la contabilidad a menudo parece el problema más automatizable: está basada en reglas.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 文章《AI附加谬误》探讨了将人工智能作为现有产品或服务的简单附加功能的局限性。作者指出，这种“附加式”AI方法往往无法充分发挥AI的潜力，真正的价值在于将AI深度整合到核心业务流程中。文章建议企业应重新思考AI的应用方式，避免将其视为可有可无的附加功能。

items.title: TrafficScout – Discover high-intent Reddit threads with AI agents
items.raw_excerpt:
I’ve used Reddit as a customer acquisition channel for years. The challenge was always the same: finding high-intent threads every day and writing replies that were useful, compliant with subreddit rules, and didn’t trigger account issues. Doing it manually worked well, but it didn’t scale and introduced risk when rushed. So I built TrafficScout, a small tool that monitors Reddit in real time, surfaces conversations where people are actively asking for tool recommendations or alternatives, and generates draft replies based on thread context and subreddit rules. I originally made it for my own products, then for a few friends, and now I’m opening it up. What it does:
• Watches Reddit for decision-making conversations (e.g., “Best CRM for small teams?”)
• Scores each thread for buying intent

Docs here: https://docs.sim.ai . You can run Sim locally using Docker, with no execution limits or other restrictions. We started building Sim almost a year ago after repeatedly troubleshooting why our agents failed in production. Code-first frameworks felt hard to debug because of implicit control flow, and workflow platforms added more overhead than they removed. items.title: Agent Lightning: Adding reinforcement learning to AI agents without code rewrites
items.raw_excerpt: By decoupling how agents work from how they’re trained, Agent Lightning turns each step an agent takes into data for reinforcement learning. This makes it easy for developers to improve agent performance with almost zero code changes. The post Agent Lightning: Adding reinforcement learning to AI agents without code rewrites appeared first on Microsoft Research .

title_i18n.en: Agent Lightning: Adding reinforcement learning to AI agents without code rewrites
title_i18n.zh: Agent Lightning：无需代码重写即可为AI代理添加强化学习
title_i18n.es: Agente Relámpago: Incorporar aprendizaje por refuerzo a agentes de IA sin reescribir código

excerpt_i18n.en: By decoupling how agents work from how they’re trained, Agent Lightning turns each step an agent takes into data for reinforcement learning. This makes it easy for developers to improve agent performance with almost zero code changes. The post Agent Lightning: Adding reinforcement learning to AI agents without code rewrites appeared first on Microsoft Research .
excerpt_i18n.zh: 通过将智能体的运作方式与训练方式解耦，Agent Lightning将智能体的每一步行动转化为强化学习的数据。这使得开发者能够轻松提升智能体性能，几乎无需额外成本。
excerpt_i18n.es: Al desacoplar el funcionamiento de los agentes de su proceso de entrenamiento, Agent Lightning convierte cada paso que da un agente en datos para el aprendizaje por refuerzo. Esto facilita a los desarrolladores mejorar el rendimiento de los agentes con casi cero esfuerzo.
